intent: Show that the monthly price of the cholesterol drug Crestor is higher in the United States than in six other developed countries.

requirements.question: How does the monthly Crestor price in the United States compare with six other countries?

units.claim: The United States has the highest monthly Crestor price at about $231, compared with about $8 to $38 in the six other countries.
accept: the United States has the tallest bar
the U.S. is the highest-priced country
the U.S. price is about $231 while every comparison country is below $40
reject: the U.S. price is described as only slightly higher
monthly prices are described as annual prices
the U.S. or a comparison country is omitted
units.evidence: Seven country bars share one dollar scale; the U.S. bar is more than six times the tallest comparison bar.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all data rows because the table has no role column
